_note: SK-3014 plan 734 v1, case shape only: titles, priority, surface and step counts as stored. Steps, expected results, hosts and every other field are stripped. Every case is backend_http or cli; the video walkthrough builder finds no chapters.

happy_path.title: A hard refusal sets blocked_at, and later turns are refused without changing the lock
The third soft refusal locks the chat: soft_refusals goes 1, then 2, then blocked_at is set
Approved turns never write blocked_at or soft_refusals, so a soft count survives later normal turns

edge_cases.title: A hard refusal sent in parallel with an approved turn on the same chat stays locked
Two soft refusals sent in parallel are both counted
A chat whose blocked_at is set but whose messages carry no refusal is still refused
A legacy debug_data.softRefusals count higher than the column is kept (rollout compatibility)
A refused first message on a brand-new UUID creates the row with the right owner and saved messages
A client disconnecting mid-stream on a locked chat doesn't unlock it
A user JWT can't clear the lock through PostgREST or call record_chat_refusal

integration_tests.title: [Backend] Run the guardrails suite and the pgTAP lock tests by hand (CI does not run them)

security_negative_tests.title: Anonymous chat turn (no token) is rejected before any refusal is recorded
Another user's turn on A's chat gets 403 and no refusal is recorded
Owner control: A's off-topic turn on A's own chat is refused and counted
Unauthenticated sweep: a garbage bearer token is rejected
Unauthenticated sweep: no Authorization header on a new UUID creates no row
Client-sent userId (anonymous): rejected by auth before the body is used
Client-sent userId (other user): B can't record a refusal on A's chat by claiming A's id
Client-sent userId (owner control): a body userId naming another user doesn't redirect the refusal
A soft-deleted user's still-valid token on the chat route

regression_checklist: 🔴 Foreign chat UUID still returns 403 before anything is written
🟡 Older app builds (no x-chat-stream-protocol header, v4 data stream) still get a locked rejection
🟡 No refusal_lock write failures in logs
